verdict.rationale: Snowflake publishes official OpenAPI-compliant REST API specifications with importable Postman collections (snowflake-rest-api-specs repo) and documents its REST and SQL APIs. These are first-party artifacts that give runnable request examples, but only after importing them into an external tool, and there is no evidence of an interactive in-docs reference; probes of the docs site's OpenAPI paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer or try-it console, runnable examples embedded in the API reference itself, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the interactive experience.
